saturn_h10_dhoka_duplicate_resolution.root_cause: In Phase 5, PDF builder had hardcoded string 'खाना 10 -> खाना 2' for all dhoka strikes. When Saturn in House 10 struck both House 2 and House 8, the second strike was rendered with the hardcoded string 'खाना 10 -> खाना 2', creating an identical duplicate row.
saturn_h10_dhoka_duplicate_resolution.resolution_applied: Changed to dynamic expression 'खाना ${d.fromHouse} -> खाना ${d.toHouse}' and implemented strict Set-based deduplication.
saturn_h10_dhoka_duplicate_resolution.verification_result: Row 1 renders H10 -> H2, Row 2 renders H10 -> H8. Zero duplication verified.
